directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for concrete pump pipe diameter on the order. The row to open is /products/electric-20-concrete-pump. It prints 100–125 mm. Electric 20 prints 80 mm. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm. 100 / 125 mm, with aggregate 4 cm and below. See /en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/. The mark 100 / 125 mm is printed on named pages only. The electric mixer, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60 print 100 / 125 mm. Sprayer hoses such as 32/38 mm or 38/51 mm belong to spraying machines. Among the trailer sheets used here, Electric 20 is the page that prints 80 mm. A spare-part elbow sold as DN200 is a parts page, not a statement that every pump outlet is DN200. If you already own 80 mm pipe, the matching printed page is Electric 20, not a blank page you fill in yourself. Electric 30, Electric 40, Diesel 30 and Electric 80 do not print a delivery-pipe diameter on the lists used here. Its other buying cells are 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, hopper 0.25 m³, 120 m / 40 m, aggregate 1–2 cm, 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm and 900 kg. The section title “Copper tube - Type K” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是只有邢台页面印了管径，订单才写管径的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-20-concrete-pump。电动20印 80 mm。它印 100–125 mm。电动15印 100–125 mm。100 / 125 mm 只印在点名的页面上。100 / 125 mm，骨料 4 cm 及以下。在此处使用的拖泵表里，印 80 mm 的是电动20。32/38 mm 或 38/51 mm 这类软管属于喷涂机。电动30、电动40、柴油30和电动80在此处使用的列表上不印输送管径。作为配件销售的 DN200 弯管是配件页，不是在说每台泵的出口都是 DN200。如果你已经有 80 mm 管，对得上的已印页面是电动20，不是你自己填空的页面。见 /zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/。电动搅拌泵、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 印 100 / 125 mm。它的其他采购格是 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、料斗 0.25 m³、120 m / 40 m、骨料 1–2 cm、2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm、900 kg。节标题「铜 管 - 型 K」来自来源页，不另加额定值。

Its other buying cells are 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, hopper 0.25 m³, 120 m / 40 m, aggregate 1–2 cm, 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm and 900 kg.

question.en: Does “Copper tube - Type K” replace It prints 100–125 mm?

answer.en: No. It prints 100–125 mm remains the printed wording for concrete pump pipe diameter on the order.
answer.zh: 不会。电动20印 80 mm。仍是只有邢台页面印了管径，订单才写管径已印的说法。
